description: On PrestoDB 0.298.1 the rendered 1_v8 returns the correct rows in a different order than the canonical query in every run. The QUALIFY elimination renders SELECT ... FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ..., COUNT(*) OVER (...) AS "_w" FROM "lineitem" WHERE ... ORDER BY "l_returnflag","l_linestatus") AS "_t" WHERE "_w" > 0. The ORDER BY sits only inside the derived table, so the result order is undefined and the variant no longer matches the canonical Q1 ordering. Trino and Athena use the same Presto-family generator and probably show the same defect; neither was run.
